script: Every shot this guy takes feels stressful because for some reason he put a basketball hoop on his balcony all the way up on the top floor. So anytime he misses, it looks like the ball could fly off the edge and give everyone watching a heart attack. And he doesn't save it every time either, because many balls have already fallen off multiple times. But the one player you can never bring here is Dennis Rodman, because he might dive chasing the rebound.
retention_tricks: High stakes fear-of-heights theme keeps viewers hooked
Fast pattern interrupts showing multiple close-call POV shots
Humorous punchline payoff at the end featuring famous NBA clip
what_makes_it_work: Inherent tension from the vertiginous skyscraper height creates extreme suspense.
First-person perspective makes the viewer feel like they are personally risking dropping the ball.
Funny, unexpected punchline at the end referencing Dennis Rodman's aggressive play style.
